1968-the-human-comedy-introductions-and-.creator: Honore De Balzac
1968-the-human-comedy-introductions-and-.description: A book by Honore De Balzac. act, there is not so very much genius in the world; and a great deal of more than fair performance is attainable and attained by more or less decent allowances or exhibitions of talent. In prose, more especially, it is possible to gain a very high place, and to deserve it, without any genius at all: though it is difficult, if not impossible, to do so in verse.

23115-the-billow-and-the-rock.title: The Billow And The Rock
23115-the-billow-and-the-rock.creator: Unknown
23115-the-billow-and-the-rock.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Scotland had not long been united with England. While the wisest of the nation saw that the only hope for the country was in being governed by the same king and parliament as the English, many of the most powerful men wished not to be governed at all, but to be altogether despotic over their dependents and neighbours, and to have their _own_ way in everything.

arxiv-2108-06773.title: Low-cost experiment to measure the speed of light
arxiv-2108-06773.creator: Faraz Mehdi, Kiran M. Kolwankar
arxiv-2108-06773.description: Abstract In this paper, we demonstrate a low-cost method to measure the speed of light. It uses instruments which are readily available in any undergraduate laboratory in a developing country and some components which are inexpensive. The method is direct as it measures the time of flight of the LASER beam and easy to implement.

arxiv-2111-10930.title: Memory erasure with finite-sized spin reservoir
arxiv-2111-10930.creator: Toshio Croucher, Joan A. Vaccaro
arxiv-2111-10930.description: Abstract Landauer’s erasure principle puts a fundamental constraint on the amount of work required to erase information using thermal reservoirs. Recently this bound was improved to include corrections for finite-sized thermal reservoirs. In conventional information-erasure schemes, conservation of energy plays a key role with the cost of erasure.

arxiv-2203-12699.title: Quantum Coherence Bounds the Distributed Discords
arxiv-2203-12699.creator: Zhi-Xiang Jin, Xianqing Li-Jost, Shao-Ming Fei, Cong-Feng Qiao
arxiv-2203-12699.description: Abstract Establishing quantum correlations between two remote parties by sending an information carrier is an essential step of many protocols in quantum information processing. We obtain trade-off relations between discords and coherence within a bipartite system. Then we study the distribution of coherence in a bipartite quantum state by using the relations of relative entropy and mutual information.

arxiv-2206-02310.title: CYRUS Soccer Simulation 2D Team Description Paper 2021
arxiv-2206-02310.creator: Nader Zare, Aref Sayareh, Mahtab Sarvmaili, Omid Amini, Amílcar Soares, Stan Matwin
arxiv-2206-02310.description: Abstract In this report, we briefly present the technical procedure and simulation steps for the 2D soccer simulation of team Cyrus. We emphasize on this document on how the prediction of teammates’ behavior is performed. In our proposed method, the agent receives the noisy inputs from the server, and predicts the ball holder full state behavior.

arxiv-2211-16162.title: Scalable Hierarchical Over-the-Air Federated Learning
arxiv-2211-16162.creator: Seyed Mohammad Azimi-Abarghouyi and Viktoria Fodor
arxiv-2211-16162.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Seyed Mohammad Azimi-Abarghouyi and Viktoria Fodor. When implementing hierarchical federated learning over wireless networks, scalability assurance and the ability to handle both interference and device data heterogeneity are crucial. This work introduces a new two-level learning method designed to address these challenges, along with a scalable over-the-air aggregation scheme for the uplink and a bandwidth-limited broadcast scheme for the downlink that efficiently use a single wireless resource. To provide resistance against data heterogeneity, we employ gradient aggregations.

arxiv-2306-16567.title: Building Trust Profiles in Conditionally Automated Driving
arxiv-2306-16567.creator: Lilit Avetisyan, Jackie Ayoub, X. Jessie Yang, Feng Zhou, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2306-16567.description: Abstract Trust is crucial for ensuring the safety, security, and widespread adoption of automated vehicles (AVs), and if trust is lacking, drivers and the public may not be willing to use them. This research seeks to investigate trust profiles in order to create personalized experiences for drivers in AVs.

arxiv-2403-05648.title: Discovery of a Rare Eclipsing Be/X-ray Binary System, Swift J010902.6-723710 = SXP 182 Facilities: Swift (XRT and UVOT), OGLE, SALT
arxiv-2403-05648.creator: Thomas M. Gaudin, Jamie A. Kennea, M.J. Coe, I. M. Monageng, Andrzej Udalski, L. J. Townsend, David A.H. Buckley, Phil A. Evans
arxiv-2403-05648.description: Abstract We report on the discovery of Swift J010902.6-723710, a rare eclipsing Be/X-ray Binary system by the Swift SMC Survey (S-CUBED). Swift J010902.6-723710 was discovered via weekly S-CUBED monitoring observations when it was observed to enter a state of X-ray outburst on 10 October 2023. X-ray emission was found to be modulated by a 182s period.

arxiv-2404-06686.title: Atlas-X Equity Financing: Unlocking New Methods to Securely Obfuscate Axe Inventory Data Based on Differential Privacy
arxiv-2404-06686.creator: Antigoni Polychroniadou, Gabriele Cipriani, Richard Hua, Tucker Balch
arxiv-2404-06686.description: Abstract . Banks publish daily a list of available securities/assets (axe list) to selected clients to help them effectively locate Long (buy) or Short (sell) trades at reduced financing rates. This reduces costs for the bank, as the list aggregates the bank’s internal firm inventory per asset for all clients of long as well as short trades.

arxiv-2409-10042.title: Cross: A Delay Based Congestion Control Method for RTP Media
arxiv-2409-10042.creator: Songyang Zhang, Changpeng Yang
arxiv-2409-10042.description: Abstract After more than a decade of development, real time communication (RTC) for video telephony has made significantly progress. However, emerging high-quality RTC applications with high definition and high frame rate requires sufficient bandwidth. The default congestion control mechanism specifically tuned for video telephony leaves plenty of room for optimization under high-rate scenarios.

arxiv-2411-15572.title: On Two Conservative HDG Schemes for Nonlinear Klein-Gordon Equation
arxiv-2411-15572.creator: Shipra Gupta, Amiya Kumar Pani, Sangita Yadav
arxiv-2411-15572.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shipra Gupta, Amiya Kumar Pani, Sangita Yadav. In this article, a hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin (HDG) method is proposed and analyzed for the Klein-Gordon equation with local Lipschitz-type non-linearity. A priori error estimates are derived, and it is proved that approximations of the flux and the displacement converge with order O ⁡ ( h k + 1 ) , O(h^{k+1}), where h h is the discretizing parameter and k k is the degree of the piecewise polynomials to approximate both flux and displacement variables.

arxiv-2412-18587.title: The allowed baryon to baryon-meson strong transitions
arxiv-2412-18587.creator: A. R. Olamaei, S. Rostami, K. Azizi
arxiv-2412-18587.description: Abstract We investigate the kinematically allowed baryon to baryon-meson strong transitions in all the light and heavy sectors. We consider only the ground state on-shell particles in the baryonic and mesonic channels. In the case of mesons, only the well-established pseudoscslar and vector nonets are involved. For the baryons, we consider the ground state spin 1/2 and 3/2 baryons.

arxiv-2502-11810.title: Exploring Novel 2D Analogues of Goldene: Electronic, Mechanical, and Optical Properties of Silverene and Copperene
arxiv-2502-11810.creator: Emanuel J. A. dos Santos, Rodrigo A. F. Alves, Alexandre C. Dias, Marcelo L. Pereira, Jr, Douglas S. Galvão, Luiz A. Ribeiro, Jr
arxiv-2502-11810.description: Abstract Two-dimensional (2D) materials have garnered significant attention due to their unique properties and broad application potential. Building on the success of goldene, a monolayer lattice of gold atoms, we explore its proposed silver and copper analogs, silverene and copperene, using density functional theory calculations. Our findings reveal that silverene and copperene are energetically stable, with formation energies of -2.

arxiv-2505-09629.title: Primes in arithmetic progressions to smooth moduli: A minorant version
arxiv-2505-09629.creator: Runbo Li
arxiv-2505-09629.description: Abstract . The author prove that there exists a function ρ ⁡ ( n ) \rho(n) which is a minorant for the prime indicator function 𝟙 p ​ ( n ) \mathbbm{1}_{p}(n) and has distribution level 65 123 \frac{65}{123} in arithmetic progressions to smooth moduli. arxiv-2601-07080.title: Magma Ocean Waves and Thermal Variability on Lava Worlds
arxiv-2601-07080.creator: Mohammad Farhat, Eugene Chiang
arxiv-2601-07080.description: Abstract Lava worlds are rocky planets with dayside skins made molten by stellar irradiation. Tidal heating on these shortest-period planets is more than skin deep. We show how orbital eccentricities of just a few percent (within current observed bounds and maintained secularly by exterior companions) can create deep magma oceans.

pmc-11367306.title: Consequences of delaying non-urgent surgeries during COVID-19: a population-based retrospective cohort study in Alberta, Canada
pmc-11367306.creator: Khara Sauro, Shabnam Vatanpour, Abigail Thomas, Adam G D'Souza, Danielle A Southern, Cathy Eastwood, Seremi Ibadin, Ayoola Ademola, Mary Brindle
pmc-11367306.description: ObjectivesTo ensure sufficient resources to care for patients with COVID-19, healthcare systems delayed non-urgent surgeries to free capacity. This study explores the consequences of delaying non-urgent surgery on surgical care and healthcare resource use.DesignThis is a population-based retrospective cohort study.SettingThis study took place in Alberta, Canada, from December 2018 to December 2021.

pmc-11449318.title: Effect of formulations over a Periodic Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with multiple depots, heterogeneous fleet, and hard time-windows
pmc-11449318.creator: Alejandro Arenas-Vasco, Juan Carlos Rivera, Maria Gulnara Baldoquín, Yangming Zhou, Yangming Zhou, Yangming Zhou
pmc-11449318.description: This article presents a novel contribution to the Periodic Vehicle Routing Problem (PVRP) by introducing two new problem formulations which differ in the usage of the crucial flow variable. The formulations are tailored to meet the specific demands of the vending machine industry in Medellín, Colombia, and require considering a PVRP with time windows, a heterogeneous fleet, and multiple depots.

pmc-11450604.title: Linking cognitive and behavioral reserve: Evidence from the CAN‐PROTECT study
pmc-11450604.creator: Dylan X. Guan, Moyra E. Mortby, G Bruce Pike, Clive Ballard, Byron Creese, Anne Corbett, Ellie Pickering, Adam Hampshire, Pamela Roach, Eric E. Smith, Zahinoor Ismail
pmc-11450604.description: INTRODUCTIONChanges to the brain due to Alzheimer's disease and other age‐related neuropathologies may present with cognitive and behavioral symptoms, even during preclinical and prodromal stages. While cognitive reserve is known to mitigate cognitive decline in the preclinical stages of Alzheimer's disease, links between cognitive reserve and behavioral symptoms remain unclear.

pmc-11716056.title: Digital Clock Assessment in South Asian Setting: Insights from the P‐CARRS study
pmc-11716056.creator: Ram Jagannathan, Deepa Mohan, Rani Komal, Dimple Kondal, Poongothai Subramani, Rima Pai, Mohammed K Ali, Sailesh Mohan, Suvarna Alladi, Nikhil Tandon, Dorairaj Prabhakaran, V Mohan, Allan I Levey, Venkat Narayan KM, Felicia Goldstein
pmc-11716056.description: BackgroundDetection of presymptomatic individuals or those with subtle cognitive changes in midlife may prevent or slow the course of Alzheimer's Disease by identifying candidates for disease‐modifying treatments. Utilizing newer delivery approaches involving digital measures shows promise for cognitive phenotyping, early detection, ease of administration, and scoring, particularly in low‐resource settings.

pmc-11720930.title: Development and validation of web-based risk score predicting prognostic nomograms for elderly patients with primary colorectal lymphoma: A population-based study
pmc-11720930.creator: Kui Wang, Lingying Zhao, Tianyi Che, Chunhua Zhou, Xianzheng Qin, Yu Hong, Weitong Gao, Ling Zhang, Yubei Gu, Duowu Zou
pmc-11720930.description: Background and ObjectivesPrimary colorectal lymphoma (PCL) is an infrequently occurring form of cancer, with the elderly population exhibiting an increasing prevalence of the disease. Furthermore, advanced age is associated with a poorer prognosis. Accurate prognostication is essential for the treatment of individuals diagnosed with PCL. However, no reliable predictive survival model exists for elderly patients with PCL.

pmc-12656694.title: Improved YOLOv10: A Real-Time Object Detection Approach in Complex Environments
pmc-12656694.creator: Qili Wu, Xin Nie, Shih-Chia Huang
pmc-12656694.description: Object detection of small and occluded targets in complex scenarios is a vital yet challenging task in computer vision, with applications in intelligent systems (e.g., kitchen safety supervision). To address limitations of existing models, this study proposes an improved YOLOv10 algorithm with three key innovations.

pmc-12698353.title: Biomechanical evaluation of patch augmentation in a rotator cuff repair model using a porcine flexor digitorum profundus tendon: influence of knot tying and time-zero stability
pmc-12698353.creator: Sung-Min Rhee, Chul-Hyun Cho, Minsung Kim, Hyo-Young Lee, Ji Hwan Kim, Yeon Soo Lee, Chris Hyunchul Jo, on behalf of Translational Research Committee of the Korean Shoulder and Elbow Society
pmc-12698353.description: BackgroundThis study evaluates the biomechanical effects of acellular dermal matrix (ADM) patch augmentation in a rotator cuff repair model and determines the effect of medial knot tying on time-zero stability.MethodsA biomechanical study was conducted using a porcine flexor digitorum profundus tendon model.

pmc-13203433.title: The Effect of Physical Exercise on Emotional Eating Among College Students: A Chain Mediation Analysis of Dietary Behavior and Body Satisfaction
pmc-13203433.creator: Qi-Yue Feng, Zi-Meng Guo, Hai-Ying Quan
pmc-13203433.description: Objective: To investigate the relationship between physical exercise and emotional eating, as well as the chain mediating effects of dietary behavior and body satisfaction therein. Methods: A survey was conducted on 575 college students using the Physical Activity Level Scale, Dutch Eating Behavior Questionnaire, Body Self-State Scale, and Eating Behavior Scale.

pmc-13330986.title: Extracellular Vesicle-Associated Non-Coding RNAs in Preeclampsia: Mechanistic Insights, Biomarker Discovery, and Emerging Nanomedicine Concepts
pmc-13330986.creator: Zhongsong Zhang, Jiahui Du, Tianze Chen, Yuanyin Teng, Junhao Chen, Yanpei Li, Yang Zhang, Yingfei Long, Chanyu Li, Zhu Wu, Na Li, Zhiling Yang
pmc-13330986.description: Preeclampsia (PE) is a complex multisystem disorder that affects 2–8% of pregnancies worldwide and poses substantial risks to maternal and fetal health. Current diagnostic approaches rely largely on clinical signs and angiogenic biomarkers, and available treatments remain primarily supportive; they do not directly reverse the placental or systemic mechanisms that drive the disease.

pmc-13415281.title: Indirect Treatment Comparison of the Efficacy of Long-Acting Injectable Cabotegravir Compared With Lenacapavir for HIV Pre-exposure Prophylaxis
pmc-13415281.creator: Neil Hawkins, Aniruddha Hazra, Marisa Brizzi, Juliette Thompson, Richard Grove, Marius Sieverding, Piotr Budnik, Jenny Scherzer, Natalya Danchenko, Sarah-Jane Anderson, Laure Dupont-Benjamin
pmc-13415281.description: IntroductionLong-acting injectable cabotegravir (hereafter referred to as cabotegravir) is the first long-acting injectable approved for pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) based on the HPTN 083 and 084 trials. Long-acting injectable lenacapavir (hereafter referred to as lenacapavir) was approved for PrEP based on the PURPOSE 1 and 2 trials.

pmc-13448665.title: Coherence and fidelity aware routing in quantum networks
pmc-13448665.creator: Hilal Sultan Duranoglu Tunc, Joy Halder, Azita Hajizade, Andreas Voigt, Bassem Arar, Riccardo Bassoli, Gerhard P Fettweis, Frank H P Fitzek
pmc-13448665.description: In quantum networks, routing mechanisms designed to deliver successfully multiple simultaneous requests to the destination under limited channel capacity should simultaneously consider resource usage optimization, entanglement-generation performance, and the quality of the end-to-end delivered entangled states. The routing approaches developed for quantum networks in the literature mostly consider the change in fidelity during routing.

pmc-13556618.title: 457. Intensive longitudinal monitoring of symptoms in response to treatment with intranasal esketamine
pmc-13556618.creator: M Saje, J Bon, A Oblak
pmc-13556618.description: BackgroundEsketamine is a NMDA receptor antagonist that has been approved as treatment for treatment-resistant depression (TRD). Unlike serotoninergic therapies requiring weeks for effect, intranasal esketamine modulates glutamate neurotransmission, often yielding symptom relief within hours and significant response rates within one month [1].

pmc-13629510.title: Unraveling the Cause of Hemolytic Anemia in the Emergency Department: A Destructive Path
pmc-13629510.creator: Morgan Walker, Chris W Baugh
pmc-13629510.description: Hemolytic anemia is a rare but potentially life-threatening condition in the emergency department (ED) that requires timely recognition and early intervention. Hemolytic anemia results from either the intravascular or extravascular breakdown of red blood cells. The most common causes of secondary hemolytic anemia include lymphoproliferative disorders, autoimmune disorders, and infections.
